title: Best Base Pal for Every Job in Palworld | All 12 Work Suitabilities Ranked | Palworld Base Guide
description: The best base Pal for every work suitability in Palworld 1.0 - Kindling, Watering, Planting, Electricity, Handiwork, Gathering, Lumbering, Mining, Medicine, Cooling, Transporting and Farming - plus the best alternatives before the World Tree.

sections.heading: A worker for every job
sections.script: A great base in Palworld is all about the right worker in the right job. In the full release, every work suitability now goes all the way up to level ten, and the strongest natural workers reach level eight. In this video we go through all twelve jobs, Kindling, Watering, Planting, Generating Electricity, Handiwork, Gathering, Lumbering, Mining, Medicine Production, Cooling, Transporting and Farming. For each one I will tell you the best Pal in the game, and where it makes sense, a strong alternative you can get before the endgame. These picks come from comparing several up to date one point zero base guides, and I only kept the Pals they agree on. Let's build the perfect base.

sections.heading: Kindling and Watering
sections.script: Let's start with the two jobs every cooking and crafting base needs. For Kindling, the best Pal is Renjishi, with level eight Kindling. It also brings Handiwork and some Gathering and Transporting, so it is useful even when the furnaces are quiet. Renjishi lives in the World Tree, so in the mid game the go to Kindling Pal is Jormuntide Ignis, with level seven Kindling. For Watering, the best Pal is Shaolong, with level eight Watering, and it can Gather too. Shaolong is also a World Tree Pal. Before that, Jormuntide is the best waterer you can get, with level seven Watering. A strong Kindling Pal keeps your furnaces and cooking pots running, and a strong Watering Pal keeps your crops and your Medicine work moving.

sections.heading: Planting and Gathering
sections.script: Next, the farm. For Planting, the best Pal is Dandilord, with level eight Planting. Dandilord also has good Handiwork and Medicine Production, which makes it one of the most valuable workers in the whole game, because one Pal covers three jobs. Before the World Tree, Lyleen is a great farmer, with level seven Planting and strong Gathering, so it can plant and harvest by itself. For Gathering, the best Pal is the legendary Jetragon, with level eight Gathering. Yes, the fastest flying mount is also the best berry picker. A more practical option is Frostallion Noct, with level seven Gathering, and it works at night, so your fields keep producing while you sleep.

sections.heading: Generating Electricity
sections.script: Electricity powers the most advanced machines in Palworld, like electric crafting stations, electric furnaces and other late game production. The best electricity Pal is Orserk, with level eight Generating Electricity. Orserk is also a tower boss partner, and you can find it in the World Tree area. Because electric machines can only work as fast as your generator, a single high level electricity Pal at your Power Generator makes a huge difference. If you are not ready for Orserk yet, use the strongest Electric Pal you have and plan to swap it out later. This is one job where upgrading your worker gives you an instant boost to your whole late game base.

sections.heading: Handiwork
sections.script: Handiwork is the job you will use the most, because it covers crafting at workbenches, building structures, and making items at almost every station. The best Handiwork Pal is Solenne, with level eight Handiwork, an endgame World Tree Pal that comes out at night. For most of the game though, the king of Handiwork is Anubis. Anubis has level six Handiwork and level six Mining, which makes it the best all round worker before the endgame. Many players keep two or three Anubis at their base. If you also have Sekhmet, its partner skill boosts Anubis' work speed, so the two are a great team at a crafting base.

sections.heading: Lumbering and Mining
sections.script: Wood and stone are what you need for almost everything you build. For Lumbering, the best Pal is Celesdir Noct, with level eight Lumbering, and the regular Celesdir is right behind it with level seven Lumbering. For Mining, the best Pal is Aegidron, with level eight Mining, but Aegidron is gated behind the story. That is why most players use Knocklem, which has level seven Mining and level seven Transporting. That combination is perfect, because Knocklem breaks the ore and then carries it to your storage by itself. Anubis is another solid miner with level six Mining. Put your best miners near your stone and ore nodes, and keep the path to storage short and wide.

sections.heading: Medicine and Cooling
sections.script: Medicine Production keeps your Pals healthy and fighting fit. The best medicine maker is Silvance, with level eight Medicine Production, from the World Tree. Dandilord can also help here with its Medicine work. For Cooling, the best Pal is Bastigor, with level eight Cooling. Bastigor is the Feybreak tower boss Pal, and you can catch it in Feybreak and later areas. The legendary Frostallion is right behind it with level seven Cooling. Cooling matters because your food lasts much longer in a Cooler Box or Refrigerator that has a cooling Pal working on it. One strong cooling Pal is usually enough for a whole base, so this is an easy job to fill.

sections.heading: Transporting
sections.script: Transporting is the job most players forget, and it is often the reason a base feels slow. Transporting Pals pick up items from the ground and from production stations and carry them to your storage. The best transporter is Knocklem, with level seven Transporting. Wumpo is next with level six Transporting, and Wumpo's partner skill also gives other Pals at the base plus one Transporting, so one Wumpo makes your whole base better at moving items. Mimog is another interesting choice, because it is very fast at carrying light items over short routes. If your storage boxes are always empty while items pile up on the floor, you need more transporters.

sections.heading: Farming
sections.script: Farming works differently from the other jobs. Farming Pals drop items when they are assigned to a Ranch, so it is not about speed, it is about which Pal you choose. Mozzarina gives Milk, Chikipi gives Eggs, Beegarde gives Honey, and Lamball gives Wool. Milk, Eggs and Honey are exactly what you need to cook Cake, which you need for breeding. Sibelyx is another great rancher, because it produces High Quality Cloth. A single Ranch with Mozzarina, Chikipi and Beegarde will keep your kitchen supplied for a long time, and it is one of the best early upgrades you can make to any base.

sections.heading: How to make any worker better
sections.script: No matter which Pals you pick, you can make them stronger. Condensing is the biggest upgrade. Each of the first three stars raises one work suitability by one, and reaching four stars raises every suitability by one. In one point zero, maxing out a Pal now takes far fewer duplicates than before. Work Suitability books can also permanently raise a job rating. And passive skills like Artisan, Serious, Work Slave or Lucky make your workers faster. Finally, use the Monitoring Stand to set work preferences, so a multi job Pal like Anubis or Dandilord stays on the job you need most.

sections.heading: Your dream base
sections.script: So here is the dream team. Renjishi on Kindling, Shaolong on Watering, Dandilord on Planting, Orserk on Electricity, Solenne on Handiwork, Jetragon on Gathering, Celesdir Noct on Lumbering, Aegidron on Mining, Silvance on Medicine, Bastigor on Cooling and Knocklem on Transporting, with Mozzarina, Chikipi and Beegarde on the Ranch. And before the endgame, Anubis, Knocklem, Jormuntide, Jormuntide Ignis, Lyleen and Wumpo will carry your base. Which Pal is the hardest worker at your base right now? Tell me in the comments.
